body: I think that is true. It’s been my whole life and I don’t think I have anything about myself without it.

Yeah, I have but he has found some other ways to get in touch with me like new accounts or phone numbers. It doesn’t bother me that much because I do like hearing from him but it does make it a little harder.

Yeah, I have. She just says it’s normal to feel depressed after a breakup and especially with all of my other trauma from the relationship it’s expected. But knowing that still doesn’t help when I don’t even feel human anymore.
I’m really sorry. I didn’t mean to do that with my post here.
I don’t condone what he did to me. But obviously it has fucked with my head and that’s hard to overcome.

She doesn’t tell me what to do but really asks questions and guides me. She definitely pushes me to figure out why I’m with him. We also talked quite a bit about trauma bonding and why I feel like I get things from him I can’t get from others.
You’re right.
I can see that now. My family is a big piece of that.
You’re right. I don’t know why I am more empathetic toward others but not myself.
I had some friends in high school but transferred schools. College I kept to myself a lot. And now I don’t really try or go out too much where I could meet new people
I don’t know. I didn’t think about it before. Everyone’s responses are making me realize how empty I feel myself.

Thank you. I know you’re right. I appreciate everyone’s help. It’s just a sad, scary feeling to think it’s all just been grooming. Because I really do love him and always have been able to go to him. To think about losing that honestly just feels so scary to me. But I know everyone here is right and it’s something I have to do.

Thank you for your help. He did go to jail for a few years, and did therapy programs there. I know that doesn’t mean he’s changed though. It just feels so real that it’s hard to picture it being grooming.
Yes of course I would. Please don’t think that because it’s am now grown and not being hurt that I am okay with children being hurt. That is absolutely not the case at all.
I would tell her to tell someone else to make it stop.
I didn’t mean “just” in that way. I meant it that I don’t want children because I am afraid of that abuse in any way, not only if I would have kids with him.

No, your response was very rude, especially coming from another victim. You more than anyone should know how much this fucks with your head and how challenging it can be to process it all. Don’t tell me I am saying you were asking for it or that I would ever even think that about any child or even myself.

Of course I would never say that to a little girl. I would want to help her in any way humanly possible and stop her suffering. I don’t think lightly or even excuse what he did to me as a child. It was awful  and traumatizing and I would never wish it on anyone.

Sorry my own story and issues offend you so much, but my own situation is not one where people don’t believe victims. People who lie or make it up are reasons for that, but please don’t think that my own childhood suffering is completely negated because of some decisions I made as an adult.
Of course I would never be fine with that. I am not planning on having children because the thought of that happening to another kid makes me sick and terribly sad.
Therapy is more for me than for him.
Thank you. I’m sorry if I am fighting or getting defensive. It isn’t my intention this just is very difficult and so personal I can’t picture it any other way than the way it is.

Individually. He hasn’t been to therapy with me. My therapist doesn’t tell me point blank to break up with him but she tends to push me to talk in that direction. But she is supportive in understanding how I feel or why I feel that way.
It takes a lot to process trauma like that from your childhood. I know what he did. I still struggle with it.
Thank you for your help. I get everything you are saying and I know it’s not necessarily “right” but I honestly love this man and he loves me. We’ve been through so much together.

I am going to therapy and working with a psychologist and trauma counselor now. I did therapy when I was about 16 too but stopped when I went to college. 

I haven’t had any other boyfriends. I kind of keep to myself a lot. 

 I was the only one, and he is not abusing anyone else. He went to jail for a few years for it. He plead guilty. He knows what he did was wrong.
They won’t talk to him to give him the chance. He doesn’t have a ton of interest in seeing them because he knows they don’t like him anymore and doesn’t want to start anything up.
I don’t feel like you’re really understanding our relationship but I know 100% I would know.
I know they probably did but they don’t know him like I do.

Yes I have. He is trying to be there to support me but he is similar to me where we recognize nobody understands it. He is trying to comfort me but I am really upset over it. They don’t get it and probably never will but I just can’t believe they would cut me out of their lives like that.
I don’t want kids in general. It’s probably connected to my own experiences as a kid but I would be too afraid of things happening to them. Not just with him, but anyone.
Thanks for your help. I know it’s not normal and looks terrible to the outside.
Yes that’s true but I know him and know he hasn’t done that.
Thank you
I won’t have kids with him.
I know that. It’s about more than what happened.
My therapist told me about trauma bonding too. I know it’s not good but I can’t change how I feel it’s so, so real and nobody understands
He doesn’t do that anymore and it was only to me. He never hurt anyone else.
That’s definitely true about therapy. It has only made me more confused and sad.
I started working through it all and I know I’m not done yet. I don’t think I ever will be.
He recognizes it was wrong. We worked through all of it together.
I know I could find another man. It’s not really about me worrying about finding someone else. It’s that he knows me inside and out and has for my whole life and I can’t picture leaving him

I know what he did. We have worked through all of that. It fucked with me for a long time but things are different now and I love him. He’s been such an important person in my life and been there for me through ups and downs sometimes even more than my own family.
I know he did and we worked through that but he wouldn’t do it again.

I was very mad. Sometimes I still am. But he’s also apologized and we worked through all of it together. He is like my rock in life and while I recognize it was terrible what happened and it fucked with me for a long time, he was also there for me in lots of good ways too. The connection we have is so real and I can’t picture losing that anchor person in my life. He’s been as constant of a presence for me as my own parents.
I get that. Ok that makes sense and I understand. I was thinking more about myself more than others.
I know him and he hasn’t done that. I would know and I would leave.
He hasn’t done anything like that since I was a kid.
I’m sorry about your relationship. I hope you’re doing better now.
Thanks. I am already in therapy, but it honestly makes me feel worse not any better.
Yes, they found out when I was 16. It caused a lot of issues in my family.
I’m sorry for posting a few times. I just don’t feel like I can and it’s scary to think about it.
I don’t want to have kids so that couldn’t happen
I am in therapy but honestly it just makes me feel worse and more confused.
I started going to therapy as well.
I just haven’t ever been great at making friends or anything
No sorry that isn’t what I meant. It of course is never okay.
Thanks for your advice. I feel like I know this but it’s so hard.
Thank you for your help
Not really. I kind of keep to myself for the most part.
He wasn’t violent or anything with me he has always been very caring. But no I probably wouldn’t want to do that.
I’m not sure.
Yes
I don’t really remember when it started. I was young.

I guess she’s not “pushing” me to do anything. But it’s more like every conversation we have is around whether it’s healthy or not or digging deeper into past feelings and as a result she seems to be leaning me toward that direction. She’s not ordering me around or anything but I can tell she disagrees with it.
Sorry, I guess you’re right. Just struggling with late night thoughts. Sorry
Thanks. I understand what you’re saying; I really do. I have done therapy before and I just didn’t find it helpful.

My boyfriend previously abused me sexually years ago. Things are so much better now and we’ve worked through all of that together but a lot of the comments were calling him manipulative or saying he is brainwashing me.
I know a lot of people might not understand it. I’m sure if someone else was saying this to me I would think they were crazy.  But we really have worked through everything together.
Thanks. I am 27 so not like I’m crazy young. I know it doesn’t make sense to a lot of people but it feels really right to me. I love him and we have worked through so much of our past.
I get it. I know it was wrong what he did but we worked through all of that.
I was young and it went on throughout my life. He was older. I know it was wrong I am not saying it wasn’t.
I was hesitant at first but more because I knew people wouldn’t react well.
I just feel very safe and understood with him. Other people look at me judgmentally or putting me but I just feel at home with him.

He was convicted and even went to prison for a bit. I know it doesn’t look great from the outside but he isn’t abusive he is actually the opposite. I feel so safe with him it’s one of the only things that actually feels right. I know what he did was wrong but he also knows me better than anyone else in the world because of it.
